title: The Midnight Mail: The Sealed Pouch
description: A packet of diplomatic dispatches vanishes from the locked mail van during the midnight run to Dover. The broken seal, a mispunched route ticket, and a brief signal stop point to someone aboard the train. Trace the packet before the dawn ferry sails.

truth.summary: Mail clerk Ada Bell used the van key during the unscheduled signal stop. She cut and remade the wax seal, then hid the dispatch pouch inside the locked luggage trunk. A duplicate ticket punch and her debt to a foreign agent reveal motive and method. Porter Finn carried a similar punch but his station record places him elsewhere.
timeline: 23:35 - Ada signs the sealed diplomatic pouch into the mail van.
23:48 - The express stops at Redbridge signal for seven minutes.
23:51 - Ada enters the locked van with the duplicate key.
23:54 - The pouch is hidden inside the railway trunk.
00:05 - Guard Arthur notices the seal has been remade.
00:20 - The train reaches Dover with the trunk still aboard.
